(কাস্টমস ও মূল্য সংযোজন কর)
প্রজ্ঞাপন

তারিখ: ০৭ জ্যৈষ্ঠ, ১৪৩০ বঙ্গাব্দ/২১ মে, ২০২৩ খ্রিস্টাব্দ

Ministry of Finance: This is the government ministry responsible for the issuance of this regulatory notification.
Internal Resources Division: This government division, under the Ministry of Finance, serves as the issuing authority for customs and value added tax notifications.

Customs Act 1969: The Government is empowered by section 19(1) of the Customs Act 1969 to amend customs notifications through consultation with the National Board of Revenue.
Value Added Tax and Supplementary Duty A: Section 126(1) of this Act provides the authority to the Government, in consultation with the National Board of Revenue, to issue or amend regulatory orders.
National Board of Revenue: This body is the consultative authority for the Government in the issuance and amendment of customs-related statutory regulatory orders.
S.R.O. 70-AIN/2020: This existing notification is amended by removing a specific condition and replacing its schedule with a new list of consumable and readily available goods.
Schedule: The previous schedule is replaced by a new list detailing specific consumable or readily available goods permitted under the referenced condition of the notification.
Steel Sheet: This commodity is included in the schedule of consumable and readily available goods, specifically defined as MS plate of six millimeters or less meeting specific standards.
Chemicals: All types of chemical products are classified within the list of consumable and readily available goods provided in the schedule.
Household and Personal Baggage: Household goods are included in the schedule of consumable and readily available items subject to the regulatory provisions of the order.
Air Conditioner: Air conditioners with a cooling capacity of up to two hundred thousand BTU are listed as consumable and readily available goods within the schedule.
Anchor Boat: Anchor boats are specified as goods within the updated schedule of consumable and readily available items.
First Schedule: The list of goods includes various vehicles classified under headings 87.02 and 87.03 of the First Schedule of the Customs Act 1969.

processed_clauses.resolved_text: ২। এই প্রজ্ঞাপন ১ জুন, ২০২৩ খ্রিস্টাব্দ তারিখে কার্যকর হইবে।

Statutory Regulatory Order: This notification specifies that the order comes into effect starting from the first day of June, twenty twenty-three.
